record.name: Cropple.AI
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Cropple is a farming advisor. It connects everything you already do, checking weather, walking fields, tracking finances, asking questions into one app that actually understands your farm.                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                          
WHAT IT DOES
                                                                                                                                                                                          
Ask anything, get answers grounded in your data: Ask Sage about pests, planting windows, irrigation, livestock care, soil amendments, market timing, anything. Cropple uses your fields, crops, animals, weather, and satellite history to give specific advice, not generic tips.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   

See crop stress before you can walk to it. Cropple pulls weekly satellite imagery for every field you've drawn and helps you understand your field's health. The map turns red where plants are struggling, green where they're thriving, often weeks before it's visible from the ground.
                                                                                                                                                                                          
Diagnose problems with your phone camera: Spotted a yellowing leaf or a chewed stem? Snap a photo and Sage suggests likely causes (disease, pest, nutrient, water stress) and concrete treatments — with confidence ratings so you know how much to trust the answer.                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                          
Track real profit, per field: Log income and expenses against specific fields. Cropple shows you actual cost per acre, profit by crop, and where you're losing money, the way good farms have always tracked it, but in seconds instead of evenings.                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
WHO IT'S FOR                                                                                                                                                                            
Crop farmers, livestock farmers, and mixed operations of every size. Whether you have one acre of vegetables or a thousand of grain, Cropple scales with you.                           
                                                                                                                                                                                          
10 Languages, including Spanish, French, Portuguese, Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, Amharic, Indonesian, Viet.
                                                                                                                                                                                       
Terms of Use (EULA): https://cropple.ai/terms

record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
KIOTI Connect brings tractor, owner, and dealer information together in one
integrated platform designed to simplify day-to-day tractor management.
Built for KIOTI tractors and tractor owners, the app provides real-time
visibility into tractor performance, maintenance needs, and location, making
it easier to keep tractors operating reliably throughout every work season.
The platform also provides access to KIOTI news, events, and current offers,
allowing users to stay informed and engaged with the KIOTI brand ecosystem.

Smart Connectivity for Tractor Owners
KIOTI Connect centralizes essential tractor data in a single dashboard. Users
can register tractors, view live performance details, review monthly reports,
check location information, and access repair histories directly through the
app. The interface is designed for all operator levels, presenting information
clearly and removing the complexity of managing tractors across multiple
platforms. In addition to ownership tools, users can explore KIOTI products,
view community updates, and discover current offers through dedicated
sections in the app.

Predictive Maintenance and Early Alerts
The app identifies potential issues before they interrupt work. Predictive
maintenance alerts help users schedule service at the right time, prevent
avoidable breakdowns, and reduce unplanned downtime. With access to
maintenance logs, warning indicators, repair details, and historical records,
operators can make informed decisions about tractor care and plan ahead
with confidence.

Integrated Service Communication With Dealers
KIOTI Connect helps owners work more efficiently with authorized dealers by
giving users quick access to accurate tractor information. When contacting a
dealer, owners can reference tractor data, maintenance history, and alerts to
support troubleshooting and service coordination. By making this information
easy to access in one place, the app improves clarity during service
conversations and helps streamline after-sales support.

Reliable Access in Low-Coverage Areas
KIOTI Connect is built for real environments where cellular coverage may
vary. The app requires an active Internet connection to log in and retrieve
tractor information, but its lightweight design helps key data load efficiently
even in areas with weaker signal strength. This supports access to important
tractor details whenever connectivity is available.

AI-Powered Assistance for Clear Insights
KIOTI Connect includes an intelligent assistant that helps translate technical
tractor data into simple, actionable explanations. Users can ask natural
questions about maintenance schedules, alerts, performance indicators, or
tractor warnings and receive clear guidance without needing to interpret
complex diagnostics.

Extend Tractor Lifespan Through Preventive Intelligence
The platform analyzes usage patterns that impact wear and long-term
performance. By surfacing insights on operating habits and system efficiency,
KIOTI Connect helps owners reduce unnecessary repairs, improve tractor
health, and extend tractor lifespan over time.

A Unified Platform for Tractor Management
KIOTI Connect provides a comprehensive toolkit for tractor ownership by
centralizing the key information operators rely on. Users can view tractor
performance data, monitor status indicators, access maintenance and repair
histories, track tractor location, and store essential contact information.
Additional sections provide access to KIOTI products, community content,
events, and current offers, supporting both ownership management and
brand engagement in one unified workspace.
By centralizing these functions, KIOTI Connect replaces fragmented
management with a single, reliable platform that supports operators in
maintaining tractor performance and staying ahead of service needs.
KIOTI Connect gives users the clarity and control required to operate with
confidence, on the field, on the job, and everywhere their tractors work.

record.description_evidence:
Ditch the spreadsheets. CropsBook replaces FarmLogs and pen-and-paper crop planning with an app that works offline — even in the field. Plan crops, track harvests, log expenses, and get AI predictions. Free to start, no account needed.

CropsBook is the all-in-one toolkit built for farmers, market gardeners, and homesteaders. Plan crops, track harvests, log expenses, manage equipment, and monitor your entire operation — without spreadsheets, without complexity, and without your data ever leaving your device.

Whether you're running a small homestead, managing a market garden, or operating a commercial farm — if you grow crops and manage land, CropsBook was built for you.

CROP PLANNING & TRACKING
Track every crop from seed to harvest. Log planting dates, varieties, plant families, days to maturity, and spacing. Organize crops by garden bed with rotation tracking to keep your soil healthy season after season. Monitor crop status through every growth stage — planned, seeded, germinated, transplanted, growing, flowering, fruiting, harvesting, and done.

GARDEN BED MANAGEMENT
Map your garden beds with dimensions, soil type, sun exposure, and irrigation method. Track what's planted where, plan rotations, and keep detailed notes on bed performance over time.

HARVEST LOGGING
Record every harvest with quantities, quality grades, and notes. Track yields per crop and per bed to understand what's working. View harvest trends over time to optimize your growing plan.

EXPENSE TRACKING
Log expenses manually, snap a receipt with AI auto-fill, or just speak it — "Forty-five dollars at Tractor Supply for seed potatoes." CropsBook categorizes everything automatically. Import bank statements to bulk-add transactions. Track expenses by category for tax time.

EQUIPMENT & MAINTENANCE
Track all your farm equipment with purchase dates, values, and maintenance schedules. Log maintenance history, set service reminders, and monitor depreciation. Never miss an oil change or belt replacement again.

WEATHER & GROWING CONDITIONS
Built-in WeatherKit integration shows current conditions and forecasts for your farm location. Plan planting windows and irrigation schedules around actual weather data.

SEED INVENTORY & SAVING
Track your seed inventory with variety, source, quantity, and germination rates. Log seed-saving records to build your own seed library over time.

REPORTS & ANALYTICS
Harvest trends, expense breakdowns, yield-per-bed analysis, crop performance comparisons — know your numbers at a glance. Export CSV data for crops, expenses, and revenue. Generate PDF reports with charts and breakdowns.

TEAM COLLABORATION
Invite farm workers and managers to your farm with role-based access. Share data across devices with cloud sync. Create invite codes for easy onboarding.

AI FARM ASSISTANT
On-device AI powers intelligent features — all running privately on your phone:
- Daily farm briefing with priorities and weather alerts
- Crop health anomaly detection and pattern analysis
- Yield predictions and growth forecasting
- Pest and disease early warning
- Soil nutrient and fertilizer recommendations
- Planting schedule optimization
- Per-crop profitability analysis
- Expense anomaly detection

YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICE
Unlike other farm apps, CropsBook is built offline-first. Your farm data is stored locally on your device — nothing is sent to our servers. All AI features run entirely on-device. No internet connection required. Optional iCloud backup keeps your data safe, on your terms. No ads. No tracking. No data selling. Ever.


User Guide: https://cropsbook.app/guide

Terms of use at: https://cropsbook.app/terms

Privacy Policy at: https://cropsbook.app/privacy

Website: https://cropsbook.app

# Local LLM – Your Private AI Assistant, Anytime, Anywhere

Run entirely offline with **no internet connection required**, ensuring your privacy and data security.  
Powered by a **quantized Google Gemma 3 local LLM model** by default, while also letting you choose and download other models directly within the app for offline use.  
This gives you the flexibility to pick the model that best fits your needs, while still delivering exceptional performance among small models.

**Lightweight & Efficient**  
Tested on iPhone 12 — uses only about **200MB of memory**, smooth even on older devices.

**All-in-One Use Cases**  
AI conversations, learning assistance, knowledge Q&A, coding, and more.

**High Coverage**  
Handles **95% of everyday AI conversation needs**.

**Privacy First**  
All processing is done locally — **no data is uploaded**.

**Flexible Model Downloads**  
Browse and download more open-source models from the model page, then use them fully offline within the app.

**Smarter Multi-Turn Conversations**  
Improved multi-turn conversation summaries help keep context organized and make longer chats easier to continue.

Whether for learning, creating, working, or casual chats, **Local LLM** is always by your side.

**Latest Updates**  
Download more open-source models directly in the app.  
Improved multi-turn conversation summaries for better context across longer chats.

record.name: Plainly AI
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Everyone around you seems to get AI. Your colleagues use it. Your kids talk about it. The news will not stop covering it.

And you are quietly wondering whether you have already fallen too far behind to catch up.

You have not. But you need somewhere that actually starts at the beginning. Without impatience. Without jargon. Without making you feel foolish for asking the questions everyone else appears to have answered already.

That is Plainly.

Plainly explains AI through your actual life. One lesson at a time, about ten minutes each. By the end of a lesson you will understand something properly, not just feel that you skimmed an article.

The first six modules are free. No credit card. No catch. If you want to keep going, the full course unlocks for a small, one-time fee. No subscription. You own it.

BUILT FOR COMFORTABLE READING 
Lessons are set in clean, generously spaced type with room to breathe. Adjustable text size, from Standard to Extra Large, applied everywhere. Full VoiceOver support and a dark mode that is easy on the eyes.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN 
The first six modules are free: What AI actually is, and what the news gets wrong Where you have already been using AI without realizing it Why AI is sometimes confidently wrong, and how to tell How AI shows up in your home, your phone, your doctor's office How to ask questions that get useful answers What AI genuinely cannot do.

Then, thirteen more modules: AI and your health, and what your doctor's tools are doing. AI and your money, including exactly how the new scams work. AI around the house. Travel, translation, and navigation. Protecting your privacy. Talking about AI with your family. Spotting deepfakes and AI-generated news. Work, creativity, the global picture, and what comes next.

EVERY LESSON INCLUDES 
A key takeaway you could repeat to someone else A question to check that it stuck Something practical to try today.

ALSO INSIDE 
A plain-English glossary of thirty-three AI terms, free to everyone A daily two-minute read, plus the last few days if you missed one A streak with a built-in grace day, and a free bonus module at seven days A shareable card when you finish.

WHO IT IS FOR 
Anyone who has been nodding along in AI conversations while quietly feeling lost. If you are over 50 and curious but wary, this was built for you. It is for anyone who wants a calm, clear explanation from someone who remembers the feeling of not knowing.

The first lesson takes ten minutes. It is free. And you will finish it understanding something.

Download Plainly and stop feeling left behind.

Get fast answers to your agriculture and home gardening questions with Tilva, Penn State Extension’s innovative digital farming assistant. Powered by PlantVillage AI, Tilva combines the expertise of our own researchers and educators with the power of technology to deliver vetted, science-based information to farmers and gardeners when you need it.  
 
Ask about soil health, agronomy, crop management, livestock nutrition, animal production, pest control, home food preservation, backyard poultry, water quality, and more. It’s like having a conversation with a trusted adviser!

 • Upload your photos to identify pests, diseases, and plants. Tilva’s image recognition feature compares your picture to trusted datasets, helping you diagnose challenges. 
 • Get real-time weather and soil data for your location, allowing you to make smarter decisions based on local conditions.  
 • Link to opportunities for more learning, targeted to your interests. View Tilva’s recommendations for workshops, online courses, certificate programs, and more. 
 • Count on ag data from trusted state agencies, market data providers, and extension networks—right from the app. 

 • Disponible en Español. Ask questions and receive answers in Spanish or English.

Depend on Tilva to provide you with extension-verified information on agriculture research and production, food, and the environment.
